records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Our year-over-year revenue increased by $54.9 million to $525.6 million.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The increase in revenue for fiscal 2021 compared to fiscal 2020 was primarily due to increases in demand for power and RF devices and increases in production capacity for our power devices.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The decrease in gross profit and gross margin for fiscal 2020 compared to fiscal 2019 was primarily due to changes in customer and product mix, higher costs driven by factory and technology transitions, underutilization at some of our facilities and higher inventory reserves related to product manufactured for Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. in the second quarter of fiscal 2020.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The decrease in gross margin for fiscal 2021 compared to fiscal 2020 was primarily due to an unfavorable product mix shift and higher factory costs as we continue to bring on additional capacity.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Operating loss from continuing operations was $313.9 million in fiscal 2021 compared to $224.1 million in fiscal 2020.
